title: Public Verification Foundations
purpose: Prove the canonical HMS research-package workflow with a curated, low-disclosure set of already-public executions.
selection_notes: Only previously published and reproduced runs were selected.
The set remains intentionally small because unaudited historical material was not promoted merely to meet a numerical target.
No candidate plaintext, route, private parameter family, hidden endpoint, or paid-tier packet is included.
release_notes: This staged set teaches the difference between an execution and a result. Its package is generated for review but is not a GitHub Release asset until a separate release gate is approved.
